To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) data augmentation, weight decay, label smoothing and dropout are the most important tricks that improve the performance of a CNN model; (b) these tricks are not mutually independent; (c) the improvement in image classification accuracy is correlated with the performance in object detection and semantic image segmentation.

the following refinements are important for training CNN models: (1) training with a large number of data augmentations (2) training with a larger number of data augmentation parameters (3) training with a smaller learning rate (4) using a large number of layers in the network (5) training with a high dropout rate.

(1) data augmentation, (2) weight initialization, (3) network architecture, (4) optimization, (5) regularization, (6) batch normalization, (7) loss functions, and (8) dropout are all important factors for the success of a CNN model.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following question: what are the most effective tricks for image classification with CNNs?

the following questions:
What are the key factors that contribute to a well-trained CNN model?
How do we improve the performance of existing CNN models?
How do these improvements impact other application domains?

the following questions: 1. How do different data augmentation techniques affect model accuracy? 2. What is the effect of training with multiple crops, horizontal flips and rotations? 3. What is the impact of different normalization techniques?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, by using a combination of these refinements, we are able improve image classification performance by ~1% on ImageNet, ~1.5% on COCO and ~2% on PASCAL VOC 2007.
, by combining the proposed refinements, we are able not only to achieve better performance on image classification but also on other computer vision applications.

, by using a combination of data augmentation techniques, regularization techniques, and optimization techniques, it is possible to significantly improve the accuracy of CNN-based image classification models.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, by carefully tuning the training procedure, we can significantly improve the model performance without any modification to the network architecture.
we have a bag of tricks to improve CNN models for image classification and transfer learning.
, by combining the bag of tricks, we are able not only to increase the performance of the state-of-the-art image classifiers, but also to improve the performance of other downstream tasks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, by combining a set of small and seemingly inconspicuous tricks, we are able, to achieve a large improvement in the final model accuracy.
, when it comes to training CNN models, there are many tricks that are often overlooked and can be easily applied to improve model accuracy.
, in order to get the best out of CNN, we need to pay more attention to the training procedure.
